title: Anti-CD154 Labeling of Peptide- and PMA-Stimulated Cells
author: Opentrons

steps.title: Add anti‑CD154 to cells
steps.instruction: Using a p20 single‑channel pipette, transfer 5 µL anti‑CD154 from a 1.5 mL screw‑cap tube into wells A1 and A2 of a 96‑well culture plate, each of which already contains 200 µL suspended cells.

steps.title: Mix anti‑CD154 with cells
steps.instruction: Mix the contents of wells A1 and A2 thoroughly with the p20 pipette to ensure uniform distribution of the anti‑CD154.

steps.title: Aliquot cells to assay wells
steps.instruction: Using the p20 pipette, transfer 40 µL of the mixed cell suspension from each of wells A1 and A2 into wells B1, C1, D1, E1 and B2, C2, D2, E2 respectively.

steps.title: Add specific stimulants
steps.instruction: Add the appropriate stimulant to each pair of wells using the p20 pipette:

substeps.instruction: Add peptide 1 to wells B1 and B2.
Add peptide 2 to wells C1 and C2.
Add peptide 3 to wells D1 and D2.
Add PMA‑Ca to wells E1 and E2.

steps.title: Adjust final well volume
steps.instruction: Optionally add 60 µL culture medium to each well A1‑E1 and A2‑E2 with the p20 pipette so that the total volume in each well reaches 100 µL.
